∀ (θ : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (J : ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.Depth r),
  ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.DepthBridge θ r J =
    (J 0 = 0 ∧
      J (Fin.last r) = 0 ∧
        (∀ (t : Fin (r + 1)), 0 ≤ J t) ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin r),
            J i.succ ≤
              J i.castSucc + ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.floorAt θ (↑i + 1) - ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.floorAt θ ↑i - 1)
(1 + 1).AtLeastTwo

∀ (θ : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (w : ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.Word r),
  ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.FloorWord θ r w =
    (0 < r ∧
      ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.PositiveWord r w ∧
        ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.wordPrefix r w (Fin.last r) = ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.floorAt θ r ∧
          ∀ (t : Fin (r + 1)), ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.wordPrefix r w t ≤ ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.floorAt θ ↑t)
NeZero (0 + 1)
∀ (r : ℕ), NeZero (r + 1)

∀ (θ : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (w : ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.Word r),
  ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.SourceWord θ r w =
    (0 < r ∧
      ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.PositiveWord r w ∧
        ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.wordPrefix r w (Fin.last r) = ⌈↑r * θ⌉ ∧
          ∀ (t : Fin r),
            ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.wordPrefix r w t.castSucc ≤ ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.literalCap θ r ↑t)
∀ (r t : ℕ), t ≤ r → ¬t < r + 1 → False
∀ (r t : ℕ), t ≤ r → t < r + 1

∀ (r : ℕ) (K : ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.Prefix r) (t : ℕ),
  ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.extendPrefix r K t = if ht : t ≤ r then K ⟨t, ⋯⟩ else 0
∀ (θ : ℝ) (t : ℕ), ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.floorAt θ t = ⌊↑t * θ⌋

∀ (θ : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (t : Fin (r + 1)),
  ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.floorPrefix θ r t = ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.floorAt θ ↑t
∀ (θ : ℝ) (r t : ℕ), ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.literalCap θ r t = ⌊↑t * θ + ExternalFiniteBridgeDraft.defect θ r⌋
